meta.title: Multi-Sport Dashboard
meta.note: Static snapshot. World Cup group stage complete (all 12 groups); Round of 32 done and the Round of 16 under way, Australia eliminated by Egypt on penalties. AFL through the played Round 17 games (two Sunday 5 July games still to come); NRL ladder reflects Round 17 with Round 18 an Origin-week round in progress; State of Origin level 1-1 with the decider on 8 July. AFL for and against and NRL differential figures could not be re-verified from source and show a dash.

mine: NRL Round 19 · AAMI Park (after the R18 bye)

focus.note: Seven straight. Josh Fraser's interim reign (Voss was sacked at 1-8 after Round 9) has hauled a dead season back to 8-8 and the fringe of the eight, capped by a two-point escape over Richmond at the MCG in Round 17.
Bellamy's final season sits 12th at 7-9, six points outside the eight after a chastening 30-4 loss to Manly. The R18 bye buys a reset before the run home.

origin.state: Series level 1–1 · decider at Suncorp Stadium, Brisbane

games.qldScorers: QLD led 20-0 early. Kalyn Ponga sent off in the 58th minute (7th in Origin history).
games.nswScorers: NSW stormed back a man up: James Tedesco the winning try, Nathan Cleary converting in the rain to win 22-20.

games.qldScorers: Tries: Selwyn Cobbo (3), Trent Loiero, Jojo Fifita, Hamiso Tabuai-Fidow, Lindsay Collins. Goals: Sam Walker 8/8 + 1 pen. MOM Sam Walker.
games.nswScorers: Tries: Kotoni Staggs, Mark Nawaqanitawase (2), Mitchell Barnett. Goals: Nathan Cleary 4.

games.qldScorers: QLD name Patrick Carrigan, Jeremiah Nanai and Corey Horsburgh and start home favourites after the 44-24 Game 2 rout, with the series on the line at Suncorp.
games.nswScorers: NSW rang six changes under Laurie Daley, including debutant winger Jack Bostock and a reshaped centre pairing of Stephen Crichton and Bradman Best.

gates.title: Survive the opening two games
gates.req: Beat Türkiye, lost to USA. Alive going into the final round.

marker.text: Branch point: the Paraguay game decided 2nd place

gates.title: Get a result against Paraguay
gates.req: Drew Paraguay 0–0 and pipped them for 2nd in Group D on goal difference. Through to the Round of 32.
gates.note: Both finished on 4 points; Australia's 0 goal difference edged Paraguay's -2.

gates.title: Win a knockout game
gates.req: Drawn against Egypt in Dallas. 1–1 after extra time, then beaten 4–2 in the shootout. Souttar's miss proved the difference.
games: R32 · 3 Jul · Dallas · lost 2–4 on pens
gates.note: The Socceroos' World Cup ends at the Round of 32.

marker.text: Out: beaten by Egypt on penalties. The run is over.

gates.title: Build a winning streak
gates.req: Five wins in a row under interim coach Josh Fraser to drag the season off the floor.

marker.text: The wall: 14th to top 8 with 8 rounds left

gates.title: Climb into the top 8
gates.req: Now 8-8 on 32 points in 11th, about four points outside the eight after making it seven wins in a row. Carlton must keep winning and get results elsewhere, and lift a modest percentage.
gates.note: Percentage still needs work: they have to win big, not just win.

gates.title: Win an elimination final
gates.req: Sneak in at 7th or 8th and you get a sudden-death final, probably away to a top-4 side.

gates.title: Survive week 2
gates.req: Another knockout. Win or season over.

marker.text: Branch: bottom-4 sides almost never win from here

gates.title: Reach the Grand Final
gates.req: Beat a minor-premiership contender, likely interstate.

gates.title: Win the flag
gates.req: One game at the MCG for the premiership. No team has won it from outside the top 8 in the modern era.

gates.title: Steady the ship
gates.req: Four wins from five since Round 11, the only loss to the Bulldogs, to stay in touch with the eight.

marker.text: The wall: 11th, four points outside the eight

gates.title: Force into the top 8
gates.req: 7-9 on 16 points, 12th and six points behind the 8th-placed Sharks. Storm must win most of their run home and reel in several teams, starting after the Round 18 bye.
gates.note: Bellamy's farewell year: the motivation is real, the maths unforgiving.

gates.title: Win a finals game
gates.req: Make the eight and you're dangerous in September, but likely start away to a top-4 team.

gates.title: Survive week 2
gates.req: Knockout football. Storm's big-game pedigree counts here.

marker.text: Branch: lower-8 sides occasionally surge (Storm have the spine to)

gates.title: Reach the Grand Final
gates.req: One win from the big dance. Storm have been here often.

gates.title: Win the premiership
gates.req: Send Bellamy out a champion. Beat the competition's best over 80 minutes at Accor Stadium.
